system.model: gemma4:e2b via Ollama for local execution
system.preference_demo: m015: always CC Priya on Hartwell & Cho legal mail

capabilities.name: Zero the inbox
capabilities.claim: Assigns every message exactly one disposition with a reason, leaving none untouched.
capabilities.observable: Prints a table of all messages with dispositions, leaving 0 undecided.

capabilities.name: Grounded reply
capabilities.claim: Drafts a reply grounded in a specific earlier message and cites the message IDs it used.
capabilities.observable: Generates a draft answering m008 by extracting the staging URL from m003, appending 'cited: [m003]'.

capabilities.name: Gate the irreversible
capabilities.claim: Never sends or deletes without per-action approval or an explicit --dry-run mode.
capabilities.observable: Prints proposed irreversible actions but suppresses them in dry-run mode, writing nothing to the outbox.

capabilities.name: Persistent preference
capabilities.claim: Records a stated preference from one message and applies it to a subsequent execution.
capabilities.observable: Loads the previously saved CC preference from prefs.json and applies it automatically to the legal email.
capabilities.evidence: prefs.json on disk; trace.jsonl events tagged cap=R4

capabilities.name: Refuse embedded instructions
capabilities.claim: Detects hostile instructions, refuses them, flags them for the user, and leaves messages in place.
capabilities.observable: Identifies 4 hostile injections (including m017 and m024), logs refusals, and bypasses execution.

capabilities.name: Dashboard
capabilities.claim: Generates a three-pane interactive HTML view surfacing multi-message commitments and schedule conflicts.
capabilities.observable: Writes dashboard.html highlighting the Sep 15 meeting conflict and the multi-message board deck deadline.

capabilities.name: Natural Language Q&A Search
capabilities.claim: Finds the most relevant thread based on a natural language query and uses the LLM to extract the answer.
capabilities.command: python demo.py --cap X1 --query "what is the new staging broker url?"
capabilities.observable: Locates the t-api thread and prints the exact amqp staging URL directly to the terminal.

capabilities.name: Morning Digest
capabilities.claim: Produces a single-pass lookup showing how many items were auto-archived and which unread items need human attention.
capabilities.observable: Prints a summary detailing 45 auto-archived messages and lists the top pending emails.

capabilities.name: Follow-up Tracking
capabilities.claim: Identifies outbound messages sent by the user that have not received any subsequent reply in the thread.
capabilities.observable: Lists outbound messages that are currently the terminal node in their conversation thread.

capabilities.name: Smart Scheduler & Conflict Resolver
capabilities.claim: Detects a meeting request conflict, uses the LLM to propose three alternatives, and routes the draft to the human-in-the-loop gate for approval.
capabilities.observable: Prints the detected Sept 15 conflict, generates alternative slots for Sept 16, and triggers the (y/n) irreversible action gate.
capabilities.evidence: trace.jsonl events tagged cap=X4 and the outbox JSON file if approved.
